newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds sharply higher, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds sharply higher, trade thin.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were sharply higher on Monday following the firm close in Chicago at the end of last week and in project "A" earlier in the day.
High protein soymeal was as much as nine stg up while Brazilian 48's were up to six stg up.
However, despite the firm market, some buyers were in evidence with Brazilian 48's trading at 217 stg a tonne in Teignmouth and home produced feed wheat pellets at 92 stg for spot in the midlands.
Rapemeal ex-mill Erith was three stg up to unchanged while resellers were one to 2.50 stg higher.
In Liverpool and Hull sellers were around two stg up.

Corn gluten feed pellets in Liverpool and Portbury were around one to two stg up while sunflower pellets ex-mill Erith were seven stg higher with imported material on the south coast two stg above Friday's levels.
